name: sdg08
title: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026)
description: The SDG 8 (Decent work and economic growth) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 7 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

geo:notes: Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg08", variables="index_sdg8", names=True)`, and its change per unit with `geo.change(df, "index_sdg8")`.

The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.

Aggregating to provinces, departments or Bolivia (`geo.aggregate`, `geo.combine`) averages the municipal values weighted by census population (`weighted_mean:population`; the 2012 census for ~2012 and the 2024 census for ~2024, loaded from the `sdg` dataset through `geo:weights`): e.g. `geo.aggregate(geo.load("sdg08"), to="department", dataset="sdg08")`. These are population-weighted approximations, not the Atlas's own department figures.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: GDO-Bolivia municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 343-unit municipality map (SDSN Bolivia 2025: municipalities and indigenous autonomies), numbered as in GADM 4.1 plus four units created since; map343; its boundary is in geo/boundaries/map343. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: mun_id
fields.title: INE municipality code
fields.description: Official municipality code of the National Statistics Institute (INE), DDPPMM (department, province, municipality) stored as an integer without the leading zero (e.g. 20101 = Nuestra Señora de La Paz), as in the Atlas. The Atlas's rows are linked to geo_id through this code.

fields.name: index_sdg8
fields.title: Decent work and economic growth index (0-100)
fields.description: SDG 8 (Decent work and economic growth) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 7 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Labour-force participation rate, women 14+ (%); Labour-force participation rate, men 14+ (%); Young women not in education or the labour force, 15-24 (%); Young men not in education or the labour force, 15-24 (%); Employment in tourism-related activities (%); Tourism share of GDP (%); Financial access points (per 100,000 people). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS8”.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg8_5_tgm
fields.title: Labour-force participation rate, women 14+ (%)
fields.description: Percentage of women of working age (14 or more) who work or look for work. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 8 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 36.1 (worst, 0) and 89.7 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 66.5 and major challenges from 43.7 on. Atlas indicator 08_05_02_01_tgm, “Tasa global de participación, mujeres (≥ 14 años) (%)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg8_5_tgh
fields.title: Labour-force participation rate, men 14+ (%)
fields.description: Percentage of men of working age (14 or more) who work or look for work. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 8 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 68.6 (worst, 0) and 92.9 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 85.8 and major challenges from 74.5 on. Atlas indicator 08_05_02_02_tgh, “Tasa global de participación, hombres (≥ 14 años) (%)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).

fields.name: sdg8_6_etm
fields.title: Young women not in education or the labour force, 15-24 (%)
fields.description: Percentage of women aged 15-24 who neither study nor take part in the labour market. Source: own calculation of the Atlas from the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 8 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 45.9 (worst, 0) and 4.8 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 10 and major challenges from 15 on. Atlas indicator 08_06_01_03_etm, “Mujeres que no estudian, ni participan en el mercado laboral (15-24 años) (%)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).

fields.name: sdg8_9_pot
fields.title: Employment in tourism-related activities (%)
fields.description: Percentage of employed people aged 14 or more who work in activities related to tourism (Bolivian classification of economic activities CAEB-2022). Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 8 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 10 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 10 and major challenges from 2.5 on. Atlas indicator 08_09_02_05_pot, “Porcentaje de población ocupada en actividades económicas relacionadas con el turismo” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg8_9_pbt
fields.title: Tourism share of GDP (%)
fields.description: Percentage of the municipality's gross domestic product that corresponds to tourism. Source: Análisis Real-Latinoamérica (AR-LAT) (2025), El sistema económico de los sistemas locales (preliminary), municipal GDP for 2016 and 2025. Initial value 2016 (stored at 2012) and final value 2025 (stored at 2024). Missing for 4 of the 343 units in the initial period and 0 in the final one. In the SDG 8 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 10 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 10 and major challenges from 2.5 on. Atlas indicator 08_09_02_06_pbt, “Porcentaje del PIB que corresponde al Turismo” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).

fields.name: sdg8_10_dsb
fields.title: Financial access points (per 100,000 people)
fields.description: Number of financial access points (bank branches, agencies and other points of service) per 100,000 inhabitants. Source: Financial System Supervisory Authority (ASFI). Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 8 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 88.7 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 18 and major challenges from 5 on. Atlas indicator 08_10_02_07_dsb, “Densidad de puntos de atención financiera (por 100,000 habitantes)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
